p01-l01.en: Good morning! I'm Pip, and today we're going on a picnic.

p01-l02.en: First, let's pack apples. Tap the basket with three apples!

p01-hint.en: Count them one by one. One, two, three!

p01-bravo.en: Yes! Three juicy apples. Into the basket they go!

p02-l01.en: Oh no, the wind blew our things all over the meadow!

p02-l02.en: Can you find the apple and the boots?

p02-hint.en: Look carefully around the whole meadow.

p02-bravo.en: You found them all! You have sharp eyes.

p03-l01.en: A furry friend followed us to the stream!

p03-l02.en: Tap the letters to spell its name.

p03-hint.en: It says meow. C — A — T.

p03-bravo.en: C-A-T spells cat! Welcome to the picnic, little cat.

p04-l01.en: Time to set the picnic blanket. Drag each fruit onto its shadow!

p04-hint.en: Match each fruit to the pale picture that looks the same.

p04-bravo.en: The blanket looks delicious. Well done!

p05-l01.en: For dessert, I baked shape cookies!

p05-l02.en: Sort the cookies: triangles in one tin, shapes with four sides in the other.

p05-hint.en: Count the sides of each cookie. Three sides means triangle.

p05-bravo.en: Every cookie is in the right tin. What a perfect picnic!
